headline: Philippines Audit Commission Flags State University Over Unused Project Budgets
summary: The Philippine Commission on Audit (CoA) flagged Polytechnic University of the Philippines for failing to spend allocated development budgets. Audit reports detailed project delays and overdue student stipend disbursements.
why: The Commission on Audit monitors public expenditure compliance and institutional transparency across Philippine state organizations.

impacts.name: Philippines
impacts.why: Audit enforcement against unutilized public budgets aims to improve fiscal delivery performance.
